+# proper_constructible_closed_exchange_heart: local proof elaboration context
+
+## Reason
+
+The constructibility pullback uses the same local transparency settings as its
+proved source lemma. Concrete pullback and derived-functor constructors are kept
+locally irreducible to avoid expanding inverse-image sheafification during proof
+elaboration. This changes only elaboration of this proof file, not any definition
+or public signature. No source-library bodies or global attributes change.
+
+## Old
+
+```lean
+set_option autoImplicit false
+```
+
+There were no additional local elaboration settings or irreducibility attributes.
+
+## New
+
+```lean
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
+
+attribute [local irreducible] upperStar upperStarFromPoint lowerStar
+  Functor.leftDerivedFunctor Functor.rightDerivedFunctor condensedAmbientExchange
+  ClosedTestDerivedExchangeModel.pull ClosedTestDerivedExchangeModel.exchange
+  ClosedTestDerivedExchangeModel.sectionsOver moduleObjectDerivedPushforward
+```
+
+The declarations themselves and all their bodies remain unchanged. All attributes
+above are local to the proof file. `Elab.async false` makes diagnostics synchronous;
+it does not skip elaboration or kernel checking.
+
+## Users
+
+| module | group holding it | effect |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Sheaf.Paper.ProperConstructibleClosedExchangeHeart | V5 | Proof assembly and local elaboration context only. |
+| Sheaf.Paper.QcqsProperConstructibleClosedBaseChange | unclaimed at inspection | Existing direct theorem consumer; its signature and proof call require no adaptation. |
+
+No semantic definition change and no forced adaptations. Targets are unchanged.
+
+## Status

+

+/-- The closed mate on a sheaf is invertible if its exact-pullback form is invertible
+on every affine quotient chart of the closed immersion.
+
+Source: blueprint latest, det-sf-comp-coherence-refinement.proof.md, (2), closed
+calculation; Stacks Project, Tags 08FI, 09T5 and 00XZ.
+(blueprint: lem-sfb-closed-exchange-heart-affine-locality).
+
+Proof: Cover Y by affine opens Spec A. The base change of c is an affine closed
+immersion and hence has the presentation Spec(A/I) for its defining ideal I.
+Its projection b to C and the affine-open inclusion j form the pullback square in
+hlocal. The base changes of the opens cover C, also when C or Y is empty.
+Ringed open restriction preserves K-injectives, and its section identity compares
+restriction of Rf_* with the direct image of the localized proper square. The
+inverse-image composition comparison compares both pullbacks around that square.
+These comparisons preserve the adjunction unit and counit, so restricting the
+original mate gives the localized mate, conjugated by these isomorphisms.
+Exact pullback commutes with the single functor; the canonical comparison between
+exact and left-derived pullback transports the localized exact mate to the ambient
+one. Apply hlocal on each quotient chart. Every open restriction of the original
+mate is invertible. Open restriction is exact, so the homology sheaves of its cone
+restrict to zero on a cover of C and hence vanish. The cone is zero, and the
+original mate is invertible. No coefficient or constructibility assertion enters
+this descent argument. -/
+theorem closed_exchange_heart_affine_locality
+    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
+    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
+    {X Y C : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
+    (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
+    (c : C ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion c]
+    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
+    (hlocal : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
+      (j : Spec (.of A) ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j]
+      (b : Spec (.of (A ⧸ I)) ⟶ C),
+      IsPullback b (ClosedTestDerivedExchangeModel.closedMap A I) c j →
+      IsIso ((ClosedTestDerivedExchangeModel.exchange Λ
+        (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (pullback.snd f j)
+          (ClosedTestDerivedExchangeModel.closedMap A I)).toCommSq).app
+        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj ((upperStar Λ (pullback.fst f j)).obj M)))) :
+    IsIso ((condensedAmbientExchange Λ
+      (g' := pullback.fst f c) (f' := pullback.snd f c) (f := f) (g := c)
+      { w := pullback.condition
+        isoPullback := Iso.refl _
+        hom_fst := Category.id_comp _
+        hom_snd := Category.id_comp _ }).app ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)) := by
+  sorry
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing
